EDITH MCP servers. stdio entries spawn a local process; url entries speak the Streamable HTTP transport. Everything here is optional — delete an entry and that tool family simply disappears. Discovered tools register as mcp__<server>__<tool> and pass through the same read-only permission gate as every other tool.

GMAIL & GITHUB ship below, disabled until you paste secrets. github wants a fine-grained PAT from https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens as "token" (Repository contents: read is enough for questions; add pull-requests: write to open PRs). zapier wants your MCP hook URL from https://mcp.zapier.com -> New MCP Server as "url" — one URL covers Gmail, Google Calendar, Sheets and Drive; Pipedream is an equivalent. Set "enabled": true on each one you fill in, then restart the bridge. Reads run immediately; sending mail or opening PRs needs the bridge started with `npm run bridge:writes` (see decideTool in bridge/server.mjs).

SECRETS: this file is NOT gitignored (only *.local is) — never commit a real token or a real hook URL.

github.comment: GitHub's official remote MCP — mail-order OAuth not required. Create a fine-grained PAT (free) at https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens and put GITHUB_MCP_PAT=github_pat_… in .env.local (gitignored). The token is read from the environment at boot — nothing secret lives in this file. Repository contents: read is enough for questions; add pull-requests: write to open PRs. Reads (issues, PRs, code search) run on the default read-only gate; opening PRs or commenting needs `npm run bridge:writes`. If the PAT is missing or still a placeholder, the server stays off with a note in the boot log instead of failing a turn mid-sentence.
github.comment2: This file is NOT gitignored (only *.local is) — a real token pasted here would be one `git add` away from exposure. Keep it in .env.local.

pipedream.comment: app: gmail | github | … scopes the tool set; empty = discover apps first. Secrets live in .env.local (gitignored): PIPEDREAM_CLIENT_ID, PIPEDREAM_CLIENT_SECRET, PIPEDREAM_PROJECT_ID — pipedream.com -> your project -> Settings. The consumer URL mcp.pipedream.net/v2 needs an interactive browser sign-in the bridge cannot perform; this developer endpoint mints its own tokens.
pipedream.comment2: Token + project headers are minted automatically from those env vars and refreshed on 401 — nothing to paste here.
pipedream.comment3: Accounts you connected at chat.pipedream.com live in a SEPARATE namespace from this project's accounts. Connect the same Gmail/GitHub accounts in the project (pipedream.com -> project -> Accounts) for the tools to act on.
